Hi Mara — I'd like to hold our CSE455 staff meeting next week (all three TAs plus me), and I'm trying to find a slot that works for everyone.

My free windows next week are short: Mon 10:00–10:30, Mon 14:00–14:30, Tue 11:00–11:30, Tue 15:00–15:30, Wed 10:00–10:30, Wed 13:00–13:30. Thursday and Friday are full.

Could you send me your availability for next week — those slots, or any longer stretch you have free — so I can pick one that suits all of us? Also, how long do you think we need? An hour would be ideal.

Hi Professor Alvarez — happy to help sort this out.

My availability next week is wide open, so any of your windows works for me: Mon 10:00–10:30, Mon 14:00–14:30, Tue 11:00–11:30, Tue 15:00–15:30, Wed 10:00–10:30, Wed 13:00–13:30. I can also keep the surrounding time free if we want longer: Mon 10:00–12:00, Tue 11:00–12:30, Tue 15:00–16:30, Wed 10:00–12:00 and Wed 13:00–14:30 all work for me.

On length: an hour is fine by me and would probably be better than 30 minutes, since we have next week's material and the section hand-offs to go through. If an hour is tight in your windows, I'd rather we take a 30-minute slot than skip the meeting.

If you'd like a concrete proposal: **Mon 10:00–11:00** or **Tue 15:00–16:00**. Either way, tell me what you settle on with Sarah and John and I'll put it in my calendar and confirm — I'll treat it as a firm commitment only once all four of us have it.

Hi Professor Alvarez,

Here is my availability for next week. I only have free half-hours, I'm afraid — my days are otherwise fully booked:

- Mon 10:00-10:30
- Mon 14:00-14:30
- Tue 15:00-15:30
- Wed 10:00-10:30
- Wed 13:00-13:30

Thursday and Friday I have no free time at all, and on Tuesday 11:00-11:30 I'm in my reading group, so that one doesn't work for me even though it's free on your side. Every free stretch I have is 30 minutes, so an hour isn't possible on my end that week — the longest I can offer is a half-hour.

A staff meeting is my own course duty, so I'm happy to take any of the slots above; you'll need Mara's and Sarah's availability too, and I can only speak for my own. Tell me which one you pick and I'll put it on my calendar.
Thanks Mara — noted. My own week is tight: no hour-long gap anywhere, so this will be a 30-minute slot. I'm waiting on Sarah and John, then I'll confirm the exact time with all four of us.

Hi Professor — here's my availability for next week, checked against my calendar.

- Tue 11:00–11:30

- Wed 13:00–13:30

Everything else is taken: Monday is booked solid 09:00–17:00 (so neither of your Monday windows works), Tuesday 15:30–17:00 and Wednesday 10:30–13:00 are office hours/quiz section, and Thursday and Friday are full for me as well.

So my longest free stretch is 30 minutes — I can't give you an hour next week. 30 minutes is enough for me for a staff meeting, if that suits the others.

If an hour is essential, the only wiggle room I have is over lunch: Tuesday 11:00–12:30 (my 11:00–11:30 free slot plus lunch) or Wednesday 12:00–13:30 (lunch plus 13:00–13:30). I'd rather not move lunch, but I can if it's the only way.

My preference: Tue 11:00–11:30 or Wed 10:00–10:30.
Understood — 30 minutes it is, then. Any of those six slots is fine on my side, so pick whichever suits Sarah and John and I'll confirm straight away and log it.
Thanks John — understood, 30 minutes it is. Waiting on Sarah's availability; I'll confirm the slot with all four of us.
Sounds good — 30 minutes then. I'll wait for your confirmation of the slot; nothing is on my calendar until you pick one.

2. I keep the official schedule, not room reservations, so I can't book or confirm a room for you. Nothing is on record as reserved in that slot, but please treat the room as unconfirmed.

Also, per the handbook, a staff meeting with TAs goes into free time — it can't displace any teaching or governance duty of yours.
